reporting-org.narrative: Nordic Impact (Previously registered as Föreningen för Solidaritet och Utvecklingsfrågor (FSUF). Organisation number unchanged.)

description.narrative: The Her Dignity project is implemented in Somaliland by Nordic Impact (previously Föreningen för Solidaritet och Utvecklingsfrågor, FSUF), in partnership with Somaliland Promoting Society (SPS). The project aims to prevent female genital mutilation (FGM) and promote the rights, health, and well-being of women and girls. Activities include community awareness campaigns, training for women and girls, community leaders, and healthcare workers, as well as capacity-building for SPS.

owner-org.narrative: This identifier refers to the Sida contribution agreement no. 17714 for the Her Dignity project, owned by Föreningen för Solidaritet och Utvecklingsfrågor (FSUF).

activity-date.narrative: The project officially commenced in Somaliland in partnership with Somaliland Promoting Society (SPS), marking the beginning of activities to prevent female genital mutilation (FGM) and promote the rights, health, and well-being of women and girls.

recipient-country.narrative: Somaliland, Somalia – location of project implementation.

recipient-region.narrative: Her Dignity is a unique project in Somaliland, working mainly in the Maroodi Jeex and Sahil regions. It supports women, girls, community leaders, and healthcare professionals to prevent female genital mutilation (FGM) and promote equality, health, and well-being in the community.

description.narrative: The Her Dignity project is implemented in Maroodi Jeex and Sahil regions of Somaliland, focusing on preventing FGM, promoting gender equality, health, and psychosocial well-being.

activity-description.narrative: Training traditional healers and birth attendants on the impacts of FGM, providing psychosocial counselling for women and girls, facilitating behavioural change and GBV counselling sessions, and holding community dialogues and debates with CSOs, health practitioners, and religious leaders.

sector.narrative: The project activities will contribute to achieving gender equality and empowering all women and girls by preventing female genital mutilation (FGM) and promoting their health, rights, and well-being in Somaliland.

tag.narrative: This project supports SDG 5 – achieving gender equality and empowering women and girls by preventing harmful practices, promoting rights, strengthening leadership, and improving access to protection and services in Somaliland.

description.narrative: The entire project budget is allocated to accountability and budgeting, including personnel costs, community awareness activities, training, and administrative expenses to implement the Her Dignity project in Somaliland.
First disbursement from Sida for the Her Dignity project, in accordance with Sida contribution agreement no. 17714.
